properties.displayName: OT Boundary - FortiGate Admin Authentication Failures
properties.description: 5+ failed admin logins to the FortiGate OT boundary firewall within 15 minutes. The FortiGate is the enforcement point between OT and IT zones — credentialed compromise here undermines the entire segmentation model. Verify source, check for follow-on successful login, escalate to OT lead if source is unrecognized.
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceEventClassID has "logauth" or (Activity has "login" and Activity has "fail")
| where AdditionalExtensions has "admin" or DestinationUserName has "admin"
| summarize FailedAttempts = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by SourceIP, DestinationUserName
| where FailedAttempts >= 5
